title: Raise conditional κ to 0.00312265044 with asynchronous helper hubs
body:
Three independent helper inputs can be retired through scalar contacts at different times. A retained owned buffer collects an input, exchanges it with a fresh arbitrary input, and injects the difference through later contacts. Four paid query subdivisions provide the required access. This changes the simultaneous-meeting contract of PR5751.

On exact [PR5774](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5774) at `7d6ec0cdef31d0c37b7d2563e709979caa0d5eae`, the complete conditional saving rises from **0.00312192127 to 0.00312265044**: **+0.00000072917 (0.0233565%)**. The exact raw crossing is `(0.00312265047577, 0.00312265047578)`. This is a small gain and does not meet the donor's one-percent target. The larger investigation continues.

The package `research/p104-asynchronous-helper-hubs` contains the temporal proof, fixed rational plan, exact constructor, literal word, source export and complete price. Two rank-nine targets become rank-five/rank-four pairs; a third becomes rank-eight/rank-one. The full caller has **13,444 productive targets, 66,906 paid calls and rank surplus 760**. It retains every local call, thin query and whole idle. All buffer initialization, storage, scalar operations, native queries, clearing and routes are charged.

Validation on head `6b936acd68a7e0f9062037900f0fe9bc4b6fdd25`:

- Primary and registered normal/optimized replay pass: all 795 input columns, 632,025 coefficients, exact temporal histories, separate dense transpose, 2,926 native maps/phases, 1,124 helper normalizers, 208 main adapters and the full physical caller.
- Both rational price engines, completion, compiler, 54 strict outer predicates and four functional checks pass. Ten word/caller/invoice controls and the native phase control reject.
- Metadata, source pins, committed bytes, official export and rendered README pass. A separate read-only, Git-free replay under `-I -O -B` with empty PATH passes in 115.057 seconds. Every payload byte and mode stays unchanged. Export SHA256: `9c788f45c96fa6d593a82df13f809ef72016fa5d60109627c037c8641f2bf8a0`.

The five inherited framework assumptions remain. The large uniform word and rounded multiplier are not materialized. Full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout. Independent acceptance and hosted scientific CI remain pending. The selected frontier is unchanged; no other PR is merged or closed.

Base main: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority revision 8. Fresh complete overlap covered 337 open PRs and 5,161 Discussion records, with sparse-local and unpublished-work limits. [Canonical investigation and current scope](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19200475).

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. PR5774 supplies the retained native copies; PR5751 the earlier paid meetings; flyingviper's PR5718 the distinct boundary bases. NOTICE retains every P104/native/helper/controller/compiler/BIT predecessor, including Joel Pulikkan's dimension-four basis. Apache-2.0.
